svg.text: Wire links: black GND, red +12V, orange +3V3, purple +5V, blue signals. Pale: strips and cuts underneath. W1-W3 run under the driver modules: fit them before the female headers.
P1 power in: 1 GND, 2 +12V (from CB1 and J1). P2 case: 1 red LED anode, 2 blue LED anode, 3 buzzer +, 4 E-stop (EN_OUT), 5 GND (LED and buzzer returns), 6 E-stop (DRV_EN).
P3 hand unit, pins 1-8 = J2 pins 1-8: GND, 3V3, joystick X, joystick Y, joystick switch, buttons 1-3. U1: tab and heatsink towards the left edge.
